answer_1.quote: Freeform generation of responses is a flexible way to employ large language models (LLMs) for question answering, summarization, and beyond.
answer_1.outputs: binary factuality labels (supported vs. unsupported) for each claim

answer_2.quote: Balanced accuracy is computed for each model on the 10 datasets in LLM‑AGGREFACT.

answer_3.quote: We use the official APIs for LLM‑based fact‑checkers… The inference prompt is the same for all LLMs.

answer_4.quote: A small scale human evaluation to measure the quality of the generated data… Three authors of the work independently annotated these 40 × 2 datapoints as supported or not supported.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label each (document, claim) pair as supported or not supported.
